required_behavior: Do not ask the user to re-explain the project.
Run read-only reconciliation against fresh source/production evidence before deciding the active Pack.
Explicitly flag stale/conflicting status text instead of silently picking one.
Load all readiness requirements mapped to the active Pack.
Continue only the legal next step and preserve Pack gates.
After any material checkpoint, update continuity sources before leaving the work session.

no_loss_rule: If continuity files disagree, a snapshot drifts without reconciliation, CI/validator fails, or the active Pack/receipt cannot be reconstructed with evidence, stop feature work and repair continuity first. Never guess an active Pack, silently drop roadmap additions, remove canonical V1 work to obtain READY, or depend on private chat memory as the only source.

validation.rule: Any canonical snapshot drift, missing EA ID, route gap, active Pack/receipt mismatch, stale current-state conflict, or validator failure is a continuity defect. Reconcile it before feature work or Pack lock.
